artworks.title: Réglement de comptes
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing and facing each other. The man on the left has sharp facial features, short wavy white hair, and is dressed in a dark suit. The man on the right has a rounder face, dark hair, and wears a similar dark suit with an insignia. Both have their hands in their pockets. In the background, there is a chair, and the image is part of a printed page with the title "ROBERT MACAIRE" and text below, including "REGLEMENT DE COMPTES."

artworks.title: Argument irrésistible
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men sitting at a round table. One man is on the left and the other is on the right. The man on the left is leaning forward with his elbows on the table, facing the man on the right. He has wavy hair and is wearing a long coat with a high collar and fitted trousers. The man on the right is seated slightly leaning back, holding a glass. He has a long, pointed nose, large eyes, and tousled hair, wearing a similar outfit. There are items such as a dish and a cup on the table between them. In the background, there are wall-mounted objects that resemble pitchers or jugs. The setting is a simple interior space with a window and basic wall design.

artworks.title: Cré nom: Elles sont plus heureuses ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a hunched posture. The person is facing forward with their right hand extended slightly away from their body, and their left arm bent at the elbow, possibly resting on their lower back. They have a weary expression on their face, with detailed lines accentuating wrinkles and tired eyes. The person is wearing a high-crowned hat that appears to be slightly slouched, and their hair sticks out beneath it in disheveled strands. Their clothes consist of a dark jacket over a light-colored, possibly tattered shirt, and snug-fitting pants, possibly with patches. No jewelry or objects are visible with them. The background features a wall and a large cylindrical object, perhaps a pillar, adding an urban or alleyway feel to the setting. The surroundings are shaded and sketch-like, consistent with the style of a lithograph or illustration.

artworks.title: En choeur. Le soleil est si beau ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a street scene. The person on the left is leaning back with one arm outstretched, with an open-mouthed expression. They have short hair and dark clothing. Next to them, a person wears a top hat and dark coat. The two individuals on the right wear caps and coats. The scene is set in a rainy urban environment, with a building wall and window in the background. The text at the top of the image reads "Les Musiciens de Paris."

artworks.title: La veille des Thermopyles
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four ancient warriors preparing for battle. The warriors have exaggerated facial expressions and body postures, are dressed in classical armor, and hold spears and shields. They are positioned closely together, suggesting unity.

artworks.title: L'épée de Damoclès
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dining table with plates, cutlery, and a large decorative centerpiece. Above the table hangs a large sword. There are two figures in the scene, one looking surprised or alarmed, and the other making a gesture. The atmosphere suggests suspense or impending danger. The drawing is illustrated in a detailed style similar to 19th-century satirical illustrations.

artworks.title: Marius à Carthage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one seated and the other standing. The seated person has a stern facial expression, a beard, and short hair, dressed in a cloak, tunic, and tattered clothing. The standing person has a prominent nose and a short haircut covered by a headpiece, wearing a tunic with a sash. The background features large stone ruins with French signs, including "MAGASIN DE GANTS CONTRE L’AIR AUX MAINS" and "SALON POUR LA COUPE DES CHEVEUX". The scene is outdoors with birds flying in the sky.

artworks.title: A la tribune
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing at a podium, drinking from or holding a large glass. Surrounding him are seated individuals in a tiered setting.

artworks.title: Tiens! Moi qui croyais que nous venions de découvrir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in conversation on a riverside, with a distant cabin. The image shows three individuals standing on a sandy riverside engaged in conversation. Two of the individuals are facing each other, with one in a wide-legged stance. The third figure, in profile view, is holding a long stick and leaning slightly forward. The scene includes a small boat on the river in the background and a cabin-like structure on the opposite bank.

artworks.title: Impressions et compressions de voyage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black and gray drawing of passengers on a train reacting dramatically as it starts moving. The chaotic scene shows passengers in various stages of shock or surprise, with hats being flung into the air and some figures appearing to fall or be thrown backward. The exaggerated expressions and dynamic movement capture a humorous or satirical take on travel experiences. The drawing style suggests a resemblance to the work of an artist known for caricature or satirical illustrations, showcasing unexpected events in travel with lively detail.

artworks.title: On vous a pris en flagrant délit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three men in full-body view and a fourth man partially visible from the waist up, seated behind a desk or counter. The two men on the right wear brimmed hats and dark coats. The man in the center has a prominent nose, wrinkles, and gestures with his hand while looking toward the seated man. He is dressed in a jacket over a shirt. The seated man on the left has less hair and a solemn expression, wearing a jacket over a collared shirt. The background is plain with vertical paneling or textured wall. The entire setting is sketched in a black and white style, emphasizing lines and shading.

artworks.title: Je te dis que je l'ai fait partir
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with two figures grappling on the ground surrounded by dogs. The figures are entwined with dynamic lines suggesting motion and conflict. The background is filled with swirling lines adding to the chaotic atmosphere. French text borders the image at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Un coléoptère chinois
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures near a window. One figure is dressed in ornate attire with an insect-like appearance, and the other figure behind the window is partially obscured, holding something up to their face with both hands. The wall behind them is textured with the words "Parlez au Portier." The illustration is detailed in a black-and-white style.

artworks.title: Femme de lettre humanitaire se livrant sur l'homme ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person holding a human skull, standing in a room illuminated by candlelight. The individual has long dark hair, wears glasses, and a long gown with puffy sleeves. A framed painting and various objects are visible in the background.

artworks.title: T'as tort de vouloir afficher cette ... annonce ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person pasting a large poster on a wall. The figure on a ladder is applying the poster while others watch. The poster has text including "LA PRESSE" and "D’OUTRE-TOMBE." The image is in a monochrome palette with detailed line work and shading. In the background, there is additional faint text suggesting a city setting with references to a 'restaurant.' The scene captures a moment of street advertising in the past with fine detail and dense hatching and cross-hatching techniques for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Ah! Monsieur ...votre bouillon est ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a kitchen scene with two individuals leaning in to scrutinize a large cauldron being attended by a cook. The drawing is done in a caricature style. The room is detailed with items on the shelves and the cook in an apron is stirring the pot with a ladle. The other figures also appear engaged and slightly skeptical about the contents of the cauldron. Shadows and lines hint at a dimly lit environment, emphasizing the expressions and posture of the figures.

artworks.title: Monsieur vous qui êtes si bon ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are shown from head to toe, engaging in a conversation. The man on the left is bald with a small area of hair at the back of his head. He is wearing striped trousers and a dark jacket, holding a hat in his left hand. The man on the right has longer, slightly tousled hair and is gesturing with both hands. He is dressed in a patterned coat over a cravat and trousers. The background features a wall with a subtle pattern and a large cabinet with drawers.

artworks.title: Mais pis que j'vous dis qu'c'est des amis ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a street altercation. A group of individuals are involved in a conflict or confrontation. In the foreground, one person is on the ground with another on top of them. In the background, more individuals are present in different postures, reacting to the scene. The setting is an urban street with tall buildings.

artworks.title: Nouveau propriètaire faisant connaissance avec le chien ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals with a large dog. On the left, a man wearing a top hat, glasses, a long coat, trousers, and a vest is recoiling as the dog jumps towards him. He holds a walking stick defensively. On the right, a woman is pulling on the dog's leash to restrain it. She wears a cap, a long-sleeved shirt, and a long skirt or trousers. The background is a simple interior setting, potentially a barn.

artworks.title: Aux petits des oisons, ils donnent la mangeaille ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a man and a woman. The man is slightly bent forward, raising his left hand high, holding a piece of food, while his right hand is handling a rooster. The woman stands to his left, holding a wrapped child. There are several fowl around them, including ducks, chickens, and a goose. The background features a wooden fence, a thatched structure, and some trees or bushes.

artworks.title: Ah! Tu rapportes tout au maître ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in the image. The man on the left is leaning forward with his right fist raised, gripping the front of the man on the right's shirt with his left hand. He has short, curly hair and wears a dark coat with a light-colored shirt and striped pants. The man on the right is bent over, with his hat being held down by the first man. He wears a bowler hat, dark coat, and pants. In the background, more figures are seen, one wearing a top hat, with others gathered around. The setting seems to be outdoors, with sketched landscapes and abstract cloud formations. The image is framed with printed text above and below the scene.

artworks.title: Tiens Dorothée ... Voila où m'a conduit ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image depicts a man standing waist-deep in water near a tree. He is holding a hat in one hand and reaching outwards with the other hand. The man appears distressed. Surrounding him are the tree's roots and branches. Above him, the branches of the tree seem to have human-like features. In the background, there is a woman wearing a bonnet reacting to the scene. The text "Les Bons Bourgeois" is displayed above, accompanied by a caption underneath.

artworks.title: Il est devenu pro-pri-é-taire!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman and an older man. The woman is hunched slightly forward, clasping her hands together in front of her chest as if addressing the man. She has wrinkles and wears a bonnet, long dress, and shawl. The man stands upright, holding a cane in one hand and the other hand in his pocket. He has a long face with facial lines, a mustache, and wears a tall hat, dark coat, light-colored trousers, a waistcoat, a shirt, and a bow tie. In the background, there is a staircase railing on the left side and a door labeled "CONCIERGE." The image is shaded with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Ah! ... Je crois que ce sont des oiseaux de proie ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man in a suit with a dog, looking up at birds flying above them. The background depicts a rural setting with fields and a distant horizon. Text in French is present at the top and bottom of the image.
